vb_textbox.text: I really wish I could give you some clear advice on which gnome to pick, or how quickly to do it, but to be honest I didn't pick up a pattern! I started by always pressing 'S' for the first round, but then started alternating, going with the colour I liked, or just getting my daughter next to me to pick!The only advice I can give is just to try and avoid being too slow or missing the time.
